text:
Noelle (Design): quick pass on Twilight Ink theme. goal: clearer multi-series charts, readable inline code, consistent CTA copy in console screenshots.

Kiran (Frontend): drop tokens so i can run the contrast checker locally

Noelle (Design): tokens: bg #071019, surface #0c1722, panel #0e1f2a, primary #ff9960, sec #56cfff, tone #b99bff, muted #90a0b2

Ami (Product): concern: retention chart mid-tier series blends with the tone color. need stronger separation for AB comparisons

Hector (Design Eng): agree. sec (#56cfff) and tone (#b99bff) collide when stacked. proposal: nudge sec toward teal (#4fdccf) or darken tone slightly

Diego (A11y): accessibility note: primary on panel is ~4.3:1 for 12px labels. legend text is 11px by default; aim >=4.5:1. prefer darkening primary to around #ff8946

Noelle (Design): i can darken primary to #ff8848 and keep other tokens. also propose legend swatch desktop 16px->18px, mobile 14px to help scannability without larger text

Kiran (Frontend): implementable. outline tricks cost canvas perf; color adjustment + swatch increase is cheapest route

Diego (A11y): also prefer focusing on color-first fixes. add storybook contrast test that flags pairs under 4.5:1 for text and 3:1 for graphical elements

Hector (Design Eng): will add generator that hue-shifts accents by +/-12/24 degrees and clamps S/L to safe ranges. wire up tests. estimate 2 dev-days + 1 for a11y fixes

Ami (Product): timeline: if we freeze tokens this week marketing can use final screenshots next week.

Noelle (Design): great. i'll update spec with primary #ff8848, swatch sizes, inline code bg (rgba(255,153,96,0.08)) for readability, and the copy table for CTA parity. posting assets here when ready. :sparkles:
